title: Programmatic Advertising Strategies for Small Businesses Wins

facts.fact: The ad:personam article states that its Self Serve DSP does not require any minimum budget.
facts.quote: it doesn’t require any minimum budget

facts.fact: The ad:personam article recommends a minimum budget of $1,000 for programmatic advertising for small businesses, to ensure substantial reach and impact.
facts.quote: the minimum recommended budget for programmatic advertising for small businesses is $1,000 to ensure substantial reach and impact.

facts.fact: The ad:personam article was last updated on July 24, 2024.
According to ad:personam, its platform supports multi-format creative uploads including GIF, JPEG, PNG, HTML5, video, and audio files.
